_transcription_note: Tier assignment and seller_class are authoritative (Build Spec v1.0 §4.1). threshold_text marked text_source=derived_from_run was transcribed from the 2026-07-27 run rationales, not read from the framework document; it must be reconciled against the framework text and any correction published as an amendment. Scoring never reads threshold_text, so Index integrity does not depend on it. declared_upstream_hash records the framework's own hash for reconciliation.

tiers.name: Ambient conditions
tiers.question: Is spending running ahead of the revenue meant to justify it?

tiers.name: Narrative break
tiers.question: Has the market stopped rewarding the story?

tiers.name: Demand reality
tiers.question: Were the customers ever there at the assumed price?

tiers.name: Systemic
tiers.question: Is stress spreading into defaults and frozen capital?

tripwires.name: Token price index
tripwires.threshold_text: Token price index above -25% year-on-year for more than eight consecutive weeks WITH volume growth decelerating

tripwires.name: Blended inference rate ratio
tripwires.threshold_text: Blended inference rate ratio narrowing (threshold defined on blended, not single-model, rates)

tripwires.name: Capex/revenue divergence
tripwires.threshold_text: AI capital spending to revenue divergence exceeding the 32% peak of the 2001 telecom cycle

tripwires.name: Free-cash-flow migration
tripwires.threshold_text: Free cash flow migrating from hyperscalers to suppliers while aggregate spending rises

tripwires.name: Component scarcity vs token deflation
tripwires.threshold_text: Memory and optics sold out with rising component prices against continued token-price deflation

tripwires.name: Capex restraint permission event
tripwires.threshold_text: A hyperscaler rewarded by the market for moderating capital spending (permission event)

tripwires.name: Guidance-raise punishment
tripwires.threshold_text: At least two hyperscalers falling 5% or more on a capital-spending raise, across two consecutive quarters

tripwires.name: Listing-window closure
tripwires.threshold_text: Primary AI listing window closing — slipped or withdrawn offerings at the largest private labs

tripwires.name: Backlog credibility break
tripwires.threshold_text: Restatement, cancellation above 10% of contracted backlog, or an auditor flag on reported RPO

tripwires.name: Media assertion flip
tripwires.threshold_text: Mainstream media tone flipping from question to assertion (requires Tier 2 confirmation; discriminator D4)

tripwires.name: Lender withdrawal
tripwires.threshold_text: A named lender failing or withdrawing from AI data-centre financing (permitting delays do not qualify)

tripwires.name: Refinancing cost escalation
tripwires.threshold_text: Refinancing completed above +300bps, or a failure to refinance

tripwires.name: Collateral haircuts
tripwires.threshold_text: GPU loan-to-value cut below 50%, or a directional break in useful-life depreciation schedules

tripwires.name: Mega-cap equity raise
tripwires.threshold_text: A second mega-cap EQUITY raise (debt issuance does not satisfy this threshold)

tripwires.name: High-yield spread
tripwires.threshold_text: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS above 400bps (discriminator D3: requires higher-quality participation)

tripwires.name: Data-centre credit basis
tripwires.threshold_text: Tech and data-centre IG option-adjusted spread basis above +75bps versus broad IG

tripwires.name: Vendor-financing scrutiny
tripwires.threshold_text: SEC attention to vendor financing, or vendor-finance share of data-centre revenue crossing its bar (press scrutiny alone does not qualify)

tripwires.name: Capex above operating cash flow
tripwires.threshold_text: Plural hyperscalers with trailing-twelve-month capital spending above operating cash flow

tripwires.name: Revenue pool contraction
tripwires.threshold_text: AI revenue pool contracting for two consecutive quarters (discriminator D1: falling prices with rising volume is a price war, not demand destruction)

tripwires.name: Cloud revenue disclosure
tripwires.threshold_text: Hyperscaler cloud revenue disclosed materially below street (numeric definition pending framework v2 — RF-2026-07-27-003)

tripwires.name: Enterprise spend withdrawal
tripwires.threshold_text: More than 30% of planned enterprise AI spend cancelled or non-renewed (postponement does not qualify)

tripwires.name: Open-weight substitution
tripwires.threshold_text: Greater than ~40% of measurable enterprise inference running on open-weight or Chinese models
search_queries: open-weight model enterprise inference share adoption

tripwires.name: Sovereignty restriction
tripwires.threshold_text: Three or more governments imposing sovereignty restrictions binding on procurement (a supranational bloc counts as one)

tripwires.name: Compute payment failure
tripwires.threshold_text: A missed or renegotiated compute payment on a major contract (a ratings action does not qualify)

tripwires.name: Private-credit vehicle gating
tripwires.threshold_text: AI-exposed private-credit vehicles imposing withdrawal gates (scope: data-centre and compute credit; clock resets at baseline — RF-2026-07-27-001)

tripwires.name: GPU securitisation default
tripwires.threshold_text: A GPU securitisation default or covenant breach

tripwires.name: Supply-chain order cancellations
tripwires.threshold_text: Memory, optics or component order cancellations (currently strongly inverted: sold out through 2026)

tripwires.name: Systemic risk-off
tripwires.threshold_text: VIX above 40 with IG spreads above +300bps and a retirement-allocation shift, in a sustained sell-the-rally regime

_hash_note: Canonical-JSON sha256 of the tripwires array as computed by scripts/validate-ai-bubble.mjs (the enforcing implementation). Non-ASCII is emitted literally, not \u-escaped — a Python generator using ensure_ascii=True will differ.
